mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, user_no, name, phone, email, password, avatar, user_type, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND (user_no = #{account} OR lower(phone) = lower(#{account}) OR lower(email) = lower(#{account})) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND (lower(phone) = lower(#{phone}) OR lower(email) = lower(#{email}))

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.user_no, u.name AS member_name, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.status AS user_status, u.last_login_time, tm.join_time, COALESCE(r.role_code, 'ADMIN') AS role_code, COALESCE(r.role_name, '企业管理员') AS role_name FROM tenant_member tm JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = tm.user_id AND u.tenant_code = tm.tenant_code AND u.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_code = tm.tenant_code LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_code = tm.tenant_code AND r.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE tm.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND tm.is_deleted = FALSE AND tm.status = 1 ORDER BY tm.join_time DESC, u.id DESC
